ScheduleResponse.description: Normal schedule response. The response dictionary documents the fields below; examples show representative values. Example time values use yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Sample schedule entries encode fields such as numeric status/platform/sequence values as strings, while the dictionary declares platform and sequence as Numbers; both representations are allowed to preserve that discrepancy.

curr_time.description: Current date and time. The dictionary describes the format as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss; examples also use "-" when data is absent.

data.description: Data keyed by a line-station identifier, shown in the example as line code, hyphen, and station code (for example, TKL-TKO).

isdelay.description: Indicates whether the train is delayed: Y = delayed, N = running on time. Documented as optional.

status.description: System status code. The dictionary gives 1 = normal and 0 = error or alert.

sys_time.description: System date and time. Examples also use "-" when data is absent.

url.description: URL for a Special Train Services Arrangement case.

ServiceArrangementResponse.description: Response example for a special train services arrangement. Fields shown are documented by example; no closed-object guarantee is made.

examples.message: Special train service arrangements are now in place on this line. Please click here for more information.

cur_time.description: Current-time field as shown in the special-arrangement example.

status.description: System status code; dictionary maps 0 to error or alert.

url.description: URL for special train services arrangement information.

StationSchedule.description: Schedule data for one line and station. Direction keys UP and DOWN are arrays of trains for that line. A data-absence example includes only current and system time.

DOWN.description: Upcoming trains in the DOWN direction. Direction destinations vary by line as described in the data dictionary.

UP.description: Upcoming trains in the UP direction. Direction destinations vary by line as described in the data dictionary.

curr_time.description: Current date and time; may be "-" in the documented data-absence example.

sys_time.description: System date and time; may be "-" in the documented data-absence example.

Train.description: A train entry. The dictionary labels ttnt, valid, and source as Dummy/N/A; their sample representations are retained without asserting additional semantics. Dictionary numeric declarations for plat and seq conflict with string representations in examples; either representation is permitted.

dest.description: MTR station code in capital letters. Dictionary describes this as 3 characters.

plat.description: Platform number for the departure/arrival train. Dictionary declares Numbers, while examples represent the value as a string.

route.description: Optional field documented for EAL only. Indicates a train to destination via Racecourse rather than Fo Tan: empty string = normal; RAC = via Racecourse station.

seq.description: Sequence of upcoming trains; dictionary gives values 1, 2, 3, 4. The sample represents the sequence as a string, while the dictionary declares Numbers.

source.description: Dictionary type: Dummy; description: N/A. The schedule example represents this value as "-".

time.description: Estimated arrival or departure time of the train, in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

timetype.description: Optional field documented for EAL only. Indicates whether the train is arriving or departing: A = Arrival, D = Departure.

ttnt.description: Dictionary type: Dummy; description: N/A. The schedule example represents this value as a string.

valid.description: Dictionary type: Dummy; description: N/A. The schedule example represents this value as a string.

info.description: Returns train arrival or departure schedules for documented MTR lines. API specification and data dictionary are version 1.7, dated 13 March 2025. Authentication requirements are not specified in the documentation.
info.title: MTR Next Train API

get.description: Returns train arrival schedule data. A valid result is returned only when the combination of line and station is correct. The station availability table in the specification and data dictionary differs in some details; the parameter descriptions preserve the documented associations without asserting that they are exhaustive. The response may instead describe a special train service arrangement, data absence, or a suspended station.

parameters.description: MTR line code. Documented codes: AEL (Airport Express), TCL (Tung Chung Line), TML (Tuen Ma Line), TKL (Tseung Kwan O Line), EAL (East Rail Line), SIL (South Island Line), TWL (Tsuen Wan Line), ISL (Island Line), KTL (Kwun Tong Line), DRL (Disneyland Resort Line). The station code must be a valid combination for the selected line.
parameters.name: line

parameters.description: Station code. Must be a valid combination with line. Documented station codes include: AEL—HOK, KOW, TSY, AIR, AWE; TCL—HOK, KOW, OLY, NAC, LAK, TSY, SUN, TUC; TML—WKS, MOS, HEO, TSH, SHM, CIO, STW, CKT, TAW, HIK, DIH, KAT, SUW, TKW, HOM, HUH, ETS, AUS, NAC, MEF, TWW, KSR, YUL, LOP, TIS, SIH, TUM; TKL—NOP, QUB, YAT, TIK, TKO, LHP, HAH, POA; EAL—ADM, EXC, HUH, MKK, KOT, TAW, SHT, FOT, RAC, UNI, TAP, TWO, FAN, SHS, LOW, LMC; SIL—ADM, OCP, WCH, LET, SOH; TWL—CEN, TST, JOR, YMT, MOK, PRE, SSP, CSW, LCK, MEF, LAK, KWF, KWH, TWH, TSW; ISL—KET, HKU, SYP, SHW, CEN, ADM, WAC, CAB, TIH, FOH, NOP, QUB, TAK, SWH, SKW, HFC, CHW; KTL—WHA, HOM, YMT, MOK, PRE, SKM, KOT, LOF, WTS, DIH, CHH, KOB, NTK, KWT, LAT, YAT, TIK; DRL—SUN, DIS. Some documentation presents adjacent station codes together in tables; they are listed individually here as documented codes. There are discrepancies between the specification and dictionary station tables, and this list does not assert a universally exhaustive contract.
parameters.name: sta

parameters.description: Language of the returned result. Defaults to English.
parameters.name: lang

value.message: Special train service arrangements are now in place on this line. Please click here for more information.

suspendedStation.summary: Suspension of East Rail Line LOW station

200.description: Success. Response examples include normal schedule data, absence of schedule data, a special train service arrangement, and a suspended-station error. These are documented response forms and examples, not a guarantee that every response contains the same fields.

429.description: Too Many Requests. The specification documents this status code but provides no response body or media type.

500.description: Internal Server Error. The specification documents this status code but provides no response body or media type.
